interpretation.verified: Player initializes is_blinking and last_blink_time. Persona render controllers select a two-half UV blink path or a 7Hz animated face atlas path.
interpretation.missing: The referenced vanilla/persona blink controller and engine persona face geometry/texture are not defined in this archive; custom player animate graph does not automatically prove the blink alias executes. Exact player blink intervals/close-open curve cannot be reconstructed from this pack alone.
interpretation.original: Soldier eye gaze, brows, combat/effort/hurt/victory/death expressions and situation arbitration are original; no documented player facial bank matching those names was found.
